changes: Scoped assertMainWorktreeReadyForMerge (done-effects.ts) so the DONE merge blocks only when a dirty tracked path overlaps the merge affected set (git diff main...story --name-status -M, both rename names, non-ASCII via core.quotePath=false), instead of on any dirty tracked file. Unrelated uncommitted work no longer blocks DONE; clobber-protection and B-e74e main-worktree-unavailable handling preserved; diff-uncomputable fails closed (block-all).
usage: On a shared main worktree, lattice story_advance DONE proceeds even when another session has unrelated uncommitted tracked files; it still refuses if a dirty file is one the merge would overwrite.
expectedOutcome: DONE allowed with unrelated dirty main (file untouched); blocked when a dirty path overlaps the merge; clean unchanged; main-worktree-unavailable still blocked.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-merge-scope-smoke.js -> 6/6: unrelated passes + byte-identical, overlapping (edit/rename-source/non-ASCII) blocks, clean passes, unavailable throws (exit 0). See evidence/transcript-diff.md; lattice validate GREEN.
outcomeDiff: Match - unrelated-dirty allowed, overlapping/non-ASCII blocked, availability preserved, clean unchanged.
limitations: Scoped to the done-effects.ts clean-check. The smoke is not in the default validate battery (backlog B-99b6). A pre-existing done-preflight-smoke summary.json fixture-drift was observed (verified not introduced by this story).
pitfalls: F-001: git core.quotePath default octal-escapes non-ASCII paths in porcelain, which would not match the -z diff set -> fixed with core.quotePath=false on git status. The affected-path diff fails closed (conservative block-all) when uncomputable, never silently clobbering.
